proof_body:
by
  intro n a x ha
  constructor
  · intro hx
    simpa using (ha.monovary hx).sum_mul_sum_le_card_mul_sum
  · intro hx
    simpa using (ha.antivary hx).card_mul_sum_le_sum_mul_sum
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a x : Fin n → ℝ), Monotone a → (Monotone x → (∑ i, a i) * (∑ i, x i) ≤ (n : ℝ) * ∑ i, a i * x i) ∧ (Antitone x → (n : ℝ) * ∑ i, a i * x i ≤ (∑ i, a i) * (∑ i, x i))
